context: Minsc has returned to the Guildhall after learning the Zhentarim plan to overthrow Nine-Fingers, and now confronts Roah Moonglow—who stands with her Zhentarim on the railing while the Guild and its supporters watch below. Roah openly taunts Minsc about his past identity as the "Stone Lord" and accuses him of atrocities, using those claims to argue that the Zhentarim takeover is a pragmatic, "greater good" solution to remove the Absolute. Minsc rejects the Stone Lord name and leans on his companions (he cites Boo and, in some variants, Jaheira) as proof he has been redeemed. The player must decide in that moment whether to side with Minsc and resist Roah or to accept Roah’s terms and the Zhentarim’s plan.
